links.outcome: Whether AI-generated summaries met the target 8-9th grade reading level and word count
links.effect: All 60 responses met the criteria for word count (<300 words) and readability (8-9th grade target).
links.quote: All 60 responses met the criteria for word count and readability.

links.outcome: Rate of inaccurate or potentially harmful AI summaries (rating 1) among reports
links.effect: Mean accuracy ratings 2.58, 2.71, 2.77 across readers; reader 1 rated three summaries as 1, reader 2 one, reader 3 none. Inter-reader agreement was low (kappa 0.33).
links.quote: For accuracy, reader 1 identified three summaries as a 1, reader 2 identified one, and reader 3 identified none.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4's baseline performance in translating musculoskeletal radiology reports into patient-friendly summaries using expert ratings; does not compare outcomes of a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
